SELECT 
    f.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE 
    s.rtype = 'Reading'
GROUP BY 
    f.School Name
ORDER BY 
    AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`) AS Total_FRPM_Count
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.rtype = 'Reading'
ORDER BY AVG(T2.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE rtype = 'Reading'
    GROUP BY cds
    ORDER BY AVG(AvgScrRead) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds;
